notes: Seven localized movable-part episodes are reported, treating each leaf of the two double-door closets separately. Open is treated as on and closed as off. Closure attribution between paired leaves is approximate because the leaves overlap in the sampled views. The late approach to the piano shows no visible state change and is not counted.
scene_description: First-person fisheye walkthrough of an apartment entry hall, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user opens and later closes two paired closet doors, a refrigerator, an upper kitchen cabinet, and a utensil drawer.
